game.name: Hollow Knight
game.frameNote: Hollow Knight times its moves in seconds and its nail hitboxes in 50 Hz physics steps, so frames here are 1/60 s, 1-based: frame N covers (N-1)/60 to N/60 s, and a hitbox counts for every frame it is out in. Startup is the first such frame.

source.name: Hollow Knight game files
source.author: Team Cherry
source.note: Hollow Knight data is read straight from the game files: timings from the Knight's HeroController and PlayMaker FSMs (Spell Control, Nail Arts and each hit object's own FSM), hitboxes from the colliders on the Knight's attack and spell objects, sprites from its tk2d animations. Damage is per hit at base level; nail damage depends on the nail upgrade.

labels.pickClass: Pick a character to see its moves by type.
labels.recovery: Frames from the last active frame until you can dash

dodge: First frame you can dash, jump or cast
attack: First frame you can attack again
